in_marathi.name: Shail
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain peak, rocky outcrop, peak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shail हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shaila', meaning a mountain peak, rocky outcrop, or peak. It is often used to represent strength, protection, calmness, and healing.
